text:
Noah (Recruiter): Quick heads-up 1 1 1 several interviewers said they submitted scorecards last night but ATS shows empty entries (zero fields). Anyone else seeing this?

Lina (People Ops): Hmm that's odd. Can you paste candidate IDs or links? Did anything change in the rubric or visibility settings?

Noah (Recruiter): CAND-9904, CAND-9911, CAND-9913. I asked two interviewers and they said the form looked normal and "submitted". No error message on their side.

Claire (Hiring Manager): I toggled the anonymize-review flag during the afternoon rollout to test blind review flows. Could that hide fields for non-admin roles? I thought it was UI-only. Link to rollout note: https://redwood.docs/interviews/anon-review

Raj (SRE): integrations-bot logged a couple failed PATCH requests around 20:14 UTC: 
```
PATCH /api/scorecards/CAND-9904 403 Forbidden
body: {"answers":{...}, "meta":{"anon_review":true}}
response: {"error":"missing_scope:scorecard.write"}
```
Looks like the authZ layer is rejecting requests when anon_review=true for interviewers in the external SSO group.

Noah (Recruiter): That explains why interviewers saw no saved data; the UI treated it as success but backend returned 403 so payload never attached. Oof.

Lina (People Ops): Ugly. Action plan: 1) Raj, can you backfill the dropped payloads from request logs? 2) I'll disable anon toggle for public interviews until we confirm perms mapping. 3) Schedule a quick 15-min heads-up to interviewers to not re-submit yet.

Raj (SRE): I'll run a log-scrape and a safe replay. SQL to find candidate rows with null scorecards I plan to use: 
```
SELECT r.request_id, r.payload, r.received_at
FROM request_logs r
WHERE r.path LIKE '%/api/scorecards/%'
AND r.status = 403
AND r.received_at >= '2026-03-24T19:00:00Z';
```
I can map payload->candidate and attach via internal admin API once we whitelist the role. ETA: 4 hours.

integrations-bot: permission-update: SSO group "interviewers" was missing scope "scorecard.write". Patch submitted to authz-service by Raj.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks. I'll flip anon toggle off for interviews by 20:45 UTC and post a short note to interviewers: "If you saw a blank scorecard after submitting, please do not re-submit until we reconcile; we'll follow up with confirmation."

Claire (Hiring Manager): Can you add a note in the hiring manager doc about this so we avoid toggling anonymize live? I will also remind my panel.

Noah (Recruiter): I'll message the affected interviewers directly with a canned line we can paste: "We detected an issue where submissions with anonymize=true were blocked; please hold off on re-submitting. We'll post when things are reconciled."

Raj (SRE): Replay plan: after Lina disables anon toggle, I'll apply a temporary authz rule to accept anon_review=true for the SSO group, run the replay with dry-run, validate attachments on staging, then execute on prod. I will also add a short fix to return client-visible error when status != 2xx.

Lina (People Ops): Assigning tasks: Raj 1 run replay + patch authz; Noah 1 outreach; Claire 1 update manager doc; Lina 1 disable toggle + post notice + follow-up PM. I'll open RECR-4180 and add timeline.

integrations-bot: RECR-4180 created by Lina (People Ops): "Anon toggle broke submissions for SSO interviewers"

Noah (Recruiter): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once backfill is done please drop the candidate links here so I can double-check scorecards are visible in the ATS. :thumbsup:

Raj (SRE): Will do. I'll post a small script when ready to show how payloads were attached and what keys were missing.

Lina (People Ops): OK closing the loop for now. We'll use this as a note in the interviewer training: "do not change anonymize settings during active interview windows" and add a line to the pre-interview checklist.

Noah (Recruiter): Calendar note: I'll add a 10-min slot at the end of the weekly interviewer sync to demo the anon workflow and the pre-interview checklist. Thanks team.
